name: SPCAM v5 (control and +4K SST warming)
size_as_stated: 285,000 randomly selected samples (160,000 for training, 125,000 for testing); 6 separate realizations of boreal winter
resolution: 13,824 local 2D GSRMs spanning 512 km with 128 grid columns spaced 4 km apart; 15-minute time-step; 15S-15N latitude belt
access: Compressed data used for main text and SI figures is publically available at 10.5281/zenodo.8024093.

scales.note: SPCAM v5 with embedded 4 km 2D CRM subdomains across a global host grid; 15-minute model time step sampled at 3-hourly intervals across six boreal winter realizations (~90 days each).
